title: Dropbox app auth token as a Bearer value in an App Authentication request
summary: A synthetic app auth token after the Bearer scheme of an Authorization header on a request to an endpoint that uses App Authentication, in a raw request, a curl option and a JSON header map.
rationale: Dropbox documents that an app auth token, the output of the client credentials grant, is supplied as a bearer token in an authorization header (claim app-auth-token-bearer-carrier) and can only be used on endpoints that use App Authentication (claim app-auth-token-exists). The Bearer header is the same carrier as the user access token's, so the header does not identify the kind of token and no subtype is inferred; the case states only the span. The token's response member, form and lifetime are not documented (claim app-auth-token-response-undocumented), so no prefix, alphabet or width is claimed and the fixture values are fixed markers. The app secret it is derived from is a different, existing family with its own Cases. The extent is the value after the scheme only. The path in the fixtures is a synthetic stand-in. Contract claims cited: app-auth-token/app-auth-token-bearer-carrier, app-auth-token/app-auth-token-exists.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#243). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value after the Bearer scheme in an App Authentication request is treated as a credential. Dropbox documents the carrier and the token's use (carrier existence only); the value admission, the extent and the choice not to attribute a subtype are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: When using an app auth token, it is supplied as a bearer token in an authorization header.
client_credentials for using client credentials to get an app auth token. App auth tokens can only be used to call endpoints that use App Authentication, not User or Team Authentication.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
